KidProfile.title: KidProfile
KidProfile.description: Stores a child's gamified profile, star balance, 205-level virtual pet companion stats, streak stats, perfect routine dates, and unlocked achievement badges.

kidName.description: Display name of the child adventurer.

currentStreak.description: Current consecutive days of task completion.

longestStreak.description: Highest consecutive days of task completion achieved.

lastCompletedDate.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) when a task was last completed.

completedDates.description: Bounded list of ISO date strings (YYYY-MM-DD) with completed tasks.

morningPerfectDates.description: Bounded list of ISO date strings where all morning routine tasks were completed.

weekendPerfectDates.description: Bounded list of ISO date strings where all weekend tasks were completed on a weekend.

unlockedBadges.description: Bounded list of unlocked achievement badge IDs.

claimedRewards.description: Bounded list of approved reward IDs.

petType.description: Species ID of the child's virtual pet companion across Sea, Land, Air, Enchantment, and Space.

petName.description: Custom name of the child's virtual pet.

petLevel.description: Current evolution/growth level of the virtual pet (1 to 205).

petXp.description: Experience points earned by feeding, playing mini-games, and raising the pet.

petHappiness.description: Happiness meter of the virtual pet (0 to 100).

petTreats.description: Number of pet treats earned from completing daily tasks and mini-games.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

QuestTask.title: QuestTask
QuestTask.description: A daily checklist task assigned to a routine with a star reward value.

title.description: Name of the daily quest task.

iconName.description: Identifier for the visual task icon.

starReward.description: Number of stars awarded on completion (1 to 50).

completedToday.description: Whether the task is marked completed for the active date.

lastCompletedDate.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) when the task was last completed.

completionCount.description: Total number of times this task has been completed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the task was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the task was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

VisualReward.title: VisualReward
VisualReward.description: A customizable visual reward gift that kids can request and redeem with parents using their earned stars.

iconName.description: Visual icon identifier for the reward.

starCost.description: Cost in stars to redeem this reward (5 to 500).

timesClaimed.description: Number of times the child has had this reward approved.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the reward was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the reward was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

GiftRedemptionRequest.title: GiftRedemptionRequest
GiftRedemptionRequest.description: A child's request to redeem a virtual gift using their star balance, which parents can approve or reject in the Parental Dashboard.

rewardId.description: ID of the VisualReward being redeemed.

rewardTitle.description: Title of the gift being redeemed.

starCost.description: Star balance deducted/reserved for this redemption (5 to 500).

kidName.description: Name of the child requesting the gift.

parentNote.description: Optional note from the parent when approving or rejecting.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the request was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the request was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user kid adventurer profile, virtual pet stats, streak history, and badge progress.

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: Daily checklist tasks scoped to the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/rewards/{rewardId}.description: Redeemable parent gifts scoped to the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/redemptions/{redemptionI.description: Child gift redemption requests that parents approve or reject in the Parental Dashboard.
